hook: Krishna water row: *298.96 vs 512* TMC ft split back in focus
hook_b: Krishna water row: *298.96 vs 512* TMC ft split back in focus
tldr: CM Revanth Reddy said the BRS government permanently surrendered Telangana's Krishna water rights; BRS leaders dispute this.

beats.what: At a press meet on Monday, Revanth Reddy blamed KCR and Harish Rao for the 2015 allocation and for not objecting to AP's Palnadu project.
beats.why: Telangana is opposing AP's Palnadu Water Grid, and both parties are trading blame over who let Krishna rights slip.
beats.care: Nagarjuna Sagar and Krishna flows feed Hyderabad's drinking water and Telangana's farms.

cards.title: 🔄 Update, midday
cards.body: At Monday's KRMB meeting in Hyderabad, AP sought 19 TMC and Telangana 21 TMC from Nagarjuna Sagar until February. No consensus: the board deferred the decision.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: He said Telangana has complained to the KRMB about Palnadu and Irrigation Minister Uttam Kumar Reddy has approached the Centre.

cards.q: What do you want to hear next on Krishna water?

qs: Was the 2015 split meant to be temporary or permanent?
What can KRMB actually order on Palnadu?

facts.t: The CM cited a *February 16, 2022* AP order on Palnadu.
Telangana proposed discussing the remaining *25 TMC* only after Hyderabad's drinking water needs are met.

viz.verdict: Both states want more than they can agree on amid drought; KRMB will discuss again
AP got about 63% of the 811 TMC ft in the 2015 arrangement
CM says capacity was raised 4x when TRS ministers were in the YSR cabinet

learn.t: KRMB = Krishna River Management Board, which manages Krishna water between Telangana and AP

watch: When the KRMB meets again on the 19 vs 21 TMC demands, and whether it acts on Telangana's Palnadu complaint.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Revanth Reddy blames BRS for permanent surrender of Krishna water

sources.name: Hindustan Times
sources.title: No consensus between Andhra, Telangana over distribution of water in Krishna river

fact: Under the 2015 split, Telangana got *298.96 TMC ft*, Andhra 512
twist: Journalists called the 2015 arrangement temporary; the CM rejected that description.
